prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A wide, cinematic aerial shot of a vast, desolate arctic landscape, dominated by an endless expanse of snow and ice under a pale, overcast sky. In the foreground, three figures in heavy, fur-lined parkas and winter gear stand clustered around a large, rectangular hole cut into the ice, peering down with tense curiosity. To the left, a black helicopter hovers just above the snow, its rotors blurred in motion, casting a faint shadow. In the distance, a jagged wall of blue-white ice forms a dramatic backdrop, with the faint outline of a crashed aircraft partially buried in the snow. The color palette is cold and muted, with whites, icy blues, and subtle grays dominating the scene, evoking a sense of isolation and suspense. The composition emphasizes the smallness of the humans against the overwhelming, frozen wilderness, with a high, almost god’s-eye camera angle and deep depth of field, lending the image a stark, cinematic quality reminiscent of classic science fiction or thriller films set in remote, inhospitable environments.
